title: A town's sewage treatment plant
body: A town's sewage treatment plant has four units. In Unit 1, floating debris is removed by sequential filtration and grit settles out by sedimentation; the liquid above is passed on. In Unit 2, this liquid is agitated mechanically while air is pumped in, and masses of microbes grow vigorously. In Unit 3, the liquid from Unit 2 stands still so that the microbial masses settle; the clear liquid is later released into a river. A small part of the settled material from Unit 3 is pumped back to Unit 2. The remaining major part is pumped into Unit 4, a large closed tank kept free of air, from which an inflammable gas mixture is collected and used as fuel in the plant.
